Task complete. Summary:

**Gap 1 (merge-not-executed) — real root cause found and fixed:** The spec's premise about PR #78/#79 didn't hold (both were actually `reject` verdicts). The real, live bug: when `gh pr create` and its `gh pr list` fallback both fail to resolve a PR, `PR_URL` is left empty — and `gh` silently resolves an empty PR argument to whatever PR matches the *currently checked-out branch* in the workspace, instead of erroring. This isn't theoretical — it's exactly what caused **claude-control PR #84 to get automatically merged without any real review** during this task's own investigation (confirmed via `gh pr view 84`). Fixed with a guard that blocks and exits the moment `PR_URL` can't be resolved, plus added decision-point logging.

**Gap 2 (untracked PRs) — done:** Added `veridian-task.py adopt`, used it to register PR #84 into the real tracking system (`task-20260726-103756-adopted-adopt-recovered-lifecycle-fix-pr84-for-r`), confirmed via `ls .../tasks/ | grep -i recovered`. Left the existing 15-minute cron to pick it up rather than hand-triggering it.

**Tests:** 4 new regression tests, all passing; full suite (23 tests) green; the exact success-criteria pytest command passes.

**PR:** https://github.com/FChecklist/claude-control/pull/87 (open, not merged, with the full honest diagnosis in the body).
